text.title: 柜台后的值班卡
text.situation:
第一位顾客到来之前，米娜在柜台后钉了一张小卡片。作为经理，她负责核对价格和联系供应商。她雇了杰伊修包并协助顾客服务。姐姐努尔周六也会来，所以员工的工作时间并不完全相同。杰伊过去独自工作，有同事还是新鲜事。米娜让他负责记录维修要求，又给他看空白卡片放在哪里。一位年长顾客来到门口，杰伊起身太快，把铅笔碰到了地上。比起掉落的铅笔，他待人的友好态度更重要。他捡起笔，听顾客说话，仔细写下姓名。

柜台值班卡
米娜——价格和供应商电话。
杰伊——维修要求和取件记录。
努尔——周六柜台服务。
订单不清楚时，先询问，再送到工作台。

paragraphs.en: Before the first customer arrived, Mina pinned a small card behind the counter. As manager, she would check prices and speak to suppliers. She had employed Jay to repair bags and help with customer service. Her sister Noor would join them on Saturdays, so the staff would not all work the same hours. Jay had worked alone before; having colleagues was new to him. Mina gave him responsibility for writing down repair requests, then showed him where the blank cards were kept. When an older customer appeared at the door, Jay stood up too quickly and knocked his pencil onto the floor. His friendly manner mattered more than the pencil. He picked it up, listened, and wrote the customer’s name carefully.

paragraphs.en:
COUNTER CARD
Mina — prices and supplier calls.
Jay — repair requests and collection notes.
Noor — Saturday counter service.
If an order is unclear, ask before sending it to the bench.

S08.Q02.P01.cue: 说说谁管理小店、谁接待顾客。
acceptableAnswers: 米娜是店铺经理。 杰伊协助顾客服务。 员工的工作时间并不完全相同。

S08.Q02.P02.cue: 说说杰伊的同事和职责。
acceptableAnswers: 有同事对杰伊来说是新鲜事。 杰伊负责维修要求。

S08.Q02.P03.cue: 说说杰伊待人的态度和工作。
acceptableAnswers: 杰伊待顾客很友好。 米娜雇杰伊修包。

S08.Q02.T01.cue: 有人问谁负责供应商电话，怎么回答？
acceptableAnswers: 米娜是经理，她负责供应商电话。
